waiver.title: AAMU - Waiver of ACT/SAT testing requirements for enrollment

test_policy.notes: Full acceptance uses a Composite Predictive Index (CPI) of 18 or higher built from high school GPA and ACT/SAT (the formula is not printed), with a GPA of at least 2.25; CPI 16 plus a 2.25 GPA gives conditional acceptance. A waiver page lets first-year applicants (U.S. residents and international students) be admitted without ACT/SAT with a final high school GPA of at least 2.25; the international page says tests are waived for admission but required for scholarship eligibility. The waiver page is worded around COVID-19 restrictions and prints no end date, so confirm it is still active for fall 2027.

requirements.notes: Apply through AAMU's own application (Future Bulldog portal); the Common App is not mentioned. The freshman page lists a $30 non-refundable application fee. International freshmen send the high school transcript to WES or another NACES member for a U.S.-equivalency and GPA evaluation (minimum GPA 2.25). The I-20 is issued only after all admission requirements are met and the required deposits for one academic year are paid; I-20 requests are accepted 60 to 120 days before the term (fall: April 15 to June 15).

deadlines.label: International application deadline (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: International page: fall May 15, spring October 1, summer March 15; applications must be received by these dates. The page gives no year, so fall 2027 is assumed. No separate domestic freshman deadline is printed on the pages checked.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Not required for native English speakers. One year of college coursework completed in an English-speaking country may waive the TOEFL/IELTS requirement. Duolingo, PTE and Cambridge are not mentioned, and no ESL or conditional-admission pathway is described on the page.

english.notes: Paper-based 500 or computer-based 178 also listed. No 1-6 band value given.

cost.notes: The figure shown is the Fall 2026 non-resident flat rate for 12-18 credit hours, commuting ($9,656 per semester), doubled; it includes mandatory fees. The page prints no separate international rate. The 'Boarding' column is $13,848 per semester but the page does not define it, so room and board are not shown (listed separately: traditional hall $1,955, Bulldog 21 meal plan $2,240; billing period not stated). Mandatory international health insurance is $1,014 (period not stated) and is not included

aid.notes: The international page says academic scholarships are available to F-1 visa students and that test scores are required for scholarship eligibility. Out-of-state awards on the scholarship page include Normalite Opportunity ($8,610 per year, must live outside Alabama, CPI 20+) and Academic Recognition ($5,000 for out-of-state students, 3.00 GPA); that page does not say whether international students qualify, so confirm with scholarships@aamu.edu.

sat.note: No SAT code is printed on the pages read.

act.note: No ACT code is printed on the pages read.
